title: Native derived Koszul braiding
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme and $\Lambda$ a commutative condensed ring with pulled-back internal modules and their relative derived tensor [sk-def-sfb-derived-tensor-hom]. Define the braiding on $D(\operatorname{Mod}_{\Lambda_X})$ to be the K-flat localization Koszul braiding, transported along the equality of this localization monoidal structure with the native derived monoidal structure. It is the actual braiding, with sign $(-1)^{pq}$ on total tensor summands of degrees $p,q$, not an arbitrary braided structure.
